title: REQ · Each ui folder holds a real tracked SVG under game/public/assets/ui
summary: icons, frames and cursors folders each contain one non-empty pixel-art SVG.
description: Context: game/public/assets/ui does not exist. Desired behavior: sound.svg, panel-frame.svg and pointer.svg are added under the matching folders, with the same content as game/frontend/public/assets/ui. Expected result: git tracks all three folders. Why: SG-2.7 requires real files so the folders are tracked.
acceptance_criteria: Given game/public/assets/ui/icons, When listed, Then sound.svg exists and is non-empty
Given game/public/assets/ui/frames and cursors, When listed, Then panel-frame.svg and pointer.svg exist and are non-empty
Given each of the three SVGs, When read, Then it has an <svg root, width and height attributes and shape-rendering="crispEdges"
technical_constraints: Reuse the existing SVG content; do not invent new art
definition_of_done: Three SVG files exist and are tracked
